item.description:
Laytee 0.14.0
Point Translate is now Laytee, with a new retro selection-tile app icon.
- Supports Apple Silicon Macs running macOS Sequoia 15 or later. - Uses compatible on-device translation sessions on macOS 15. - A simpler disk image shows Laytee, a drag arrow, and Applications, without Install.txt. - Existing language preferences, saved translations and update identity are retained.
Built and signed locally. Not notarized. The Sequoia translation path passed local integration checks on a newer Mac; an actual macOS 15 installation has not yet been tested.
